Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		obsUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = uid),
		copy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(b|b.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		obsUser.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		copy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		obsUser.UserID = uid and
		copy.Barcode = barcode and
		obsUser.BorrowStatus = NORMAL and
		User.allInstance()->includes(obsUser) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(copy) and
		copy.Status = AVAILABLE
	postcondition:
		let loan: Loan in
		(loan.oclIsNew() and
		loan.LoanedUser = obsUser and
		loan.LoanedCopy = copy and
		copy.Status = LOANED and
		obsUser.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and
		result = true)
}
